rich_summary: As Ayodhya fills with crowds and celebration for the anticipated coronation of Rama, the city glitters with garlands, music, and joyful citizens awaiting the prince’s installation as heir under the Pushya star. From a palace balcony, Kaikeyi’s hunchbacked maid Manthara observes the festivities and learns from Rama’s nurse that King Dasaratha will enthrone Rama the next morning. Consumed by jealousy and malice, she rushes to Queen Kaikeyi’s chamber and awakens her with ominous warnings. Pretending concern, Manthara manipulates the queen, claiming that Rama’s coronation will elevate Kaushalya and endanger Kaikeyi and her son Bharata. By portraying the king as deceitful and Rama as a hidden threat, she begins planting the suspicion that will soon alter the fate of the royal family and trigger Rama’s exile.

highlight_spans.why: Vivid opening description of Ayodhya overflowing with people and celebration, establishing the grand atmosphere before the intrigue begins.
The key revelation: Rama’s nurse announces that King Dasaratha will install Rama as Yuvaraja under the Pushya star.
Manthara’s jealous fury ignites here, marking the emotional turning point that drives the coming disaster.
Manthara awakens Kaikeyi with ominous warnings, beginning the manipulation that will ultimately lead to Rama’s exile.
Her serpent metaphor—likening Kaikeyi to someone nursing a snake—reveals the cunning rhetoric she uses to poison the queen’s mind.

top_scenes.scene_text: From a palace balcony, the hunchback Manthara looks out over Ayodhya glittering with garlands, banners, elephants, and vast joyful crowds celebrating Rama’s coming coronation.
Manthara, hunched and intense, shakes the sleeping Queen Kaikeyi awake in a dim royal chamber, whispering urgent warnings of danger as palace lamps flicker.
